name: statejar
description: Verifiable memory for Codex: recalls what a session needs from your StateJar memory, captures the facts you state (secrets removed), and gives Codex StateJar's tools. Every recall names its handle and is an audited disclosure.

interface.shortDescription: Verifiable memory: recall, capture and StateJar's tools
interface.longDescription: Recalls the memory a session or prompt needs (the whole state while it is small, only the fields a question needs once it is large), captures the facts you state in batches with secrets removed, and adds StateJar's MCP tools. Every recall names the handle (shm_…) of the state it came from and is written to your audit trail.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
